articles.title: Same Question, Different Answers: Evaluating LLM Reliability Beyond Accuracy
articles.summary: arXiv:2607.22554v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong accuracy on benchmarks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they apply this knowledge when the same question is phrased in different but equivalent ways. In this work, we study how model answers change under meaning-preserving paraphrases across factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks.
